# Signed money difference between exact and billed clicks

> `adjust` computes a signed cent amount, (exact clicks minus billed clicks) times the campaign's price per click, and uses it to under-bill or refund one campaign hour.

_Part of [Correction of one hour with an ADJUSTMENT journal](adjust-journal.md)_

When the daily reconciliation finds a billed hour whose click count differs from the exact count in the raw click log, it calls `adjust`. See [Daily reconciliation against the raw click log](daily-reconciliation.md) and [Correction of one hour with an ADJUSTMENT journal](adjust-journal.md). `adjust` first loads the campaign's shop and its price per click in cents (`cpcCents`). It then works out the signed difference: `(exactClicks - billedClicks) * cpcCents`. A positive number means the shop was under-billed and owes more. A negative number means it was over-billed and gets a refund. Zero means no money moves. The sign then drives the ledger journal. The shop account gets `-delta` and the platform fees account gets `+delta`. So a positive difference takes money from the shop, and a negative one gives it back. The difference is not capped by the daily budget, unlike a normal charge in [Hourly billing job charging each campaign once](hourly-billing.md).

**Look at:** [ad-billing.jobs.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/marketing/infra/ad-billing.jobs.ts)

## Pieces

- Signed money difference in cents: The value `delta`, calculated as exact clicks minus billed clicks, times the price per click in cents.
- Journal lines that follow from the sign: The shop account gets `-delta` and `PLATFORM_FEES` gets `+delta`, so the journal sums to zero.

## What it touches

| Kind | Name | How |
|---|---|---|
| database | `AdCampaign` | Read to get the campaign's `shopId` and `cpcCents` (price per click in cents). |
| database | `AdBillingRun` | Updated with `reconciledClicks` and `adjustmentJournalId`, only if `reconciledClicks` is still null. |
| other | `ADJUSTMENT ledger journal` | Posted through `LedgerService.post` in the same transaction, with the shop and platform fees lines. |

## Also relies on

- [Recording money in the ledger](../domain-payments/recording-money-in-ledger.md) (domain/payments): Posts the `ADJUSTMENT` journal using [`LedgerService`](../domain-payments/recording-money-in-ledger.md).

## Watch out

- A zero difference still marks the run as reconciled, but no journal is posted.
- Only runs whose `reconciledClicks` is still null are updated. A second call does nothing, so the correction happens once.
- Unlike `charge`, the difference is not limited by the daily budget.
- The amounts are in cents and the sign is easy to flip. A positive `delta` means under-billed, so the shop line is `-delta`.
